scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional muted-pastel palette and clean card layout show real design thought, but the edge bundles tangle into an unreadable mass at the root and the visualization is cropped before the full circle-pack is visible, undermining the core data encoding.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout: scaleSqrt correctly used for force-layout node sizing, d3.pack handles area-based circles natively, data-driven domains via d3.extent/root.height, and key functions present on both node and link data joins.
scores.stress_test_note: The tension and easing-param sliders both trigger expensive unthrottled DOM mutations at input-event frequency (60fps), and a broken .transitioning guard means the only attempted rate-limit never fires.
scores.cognitive_load_note: The circle pack hierarchy reads cleanly with a restrained 4-color palette, but the edge bundles converge into a dense central tangle that obscures all connection structure — the spaghetti threshold is breached at the root, making individual links untraceable without hover interaction.
